- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined the maintenance process for the air conditioning system, including:
  - Visual inspection of components.
  - Pressure test for leaks.
  - Refrigerant level check.
  - Air filter cleaning or replacement.
  - Condenser coil cleaning.
  - Drainage system check.
  - Refrigerant recharge if low.
  - Leak repair if detected.
  - Component replacement if necessary.
  - System performance test.
  - Deodorizing and sanitizing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that the average cost for an AC system service is between $100 to $300.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering performing some maintenance tasks themselves, specifically cleaning the air filter and condenser coils.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised that while some tasks can be done by the user, tasks like refrigerant level check and component replacements are best left to professionals.
